title: ynh agent run --format json
description: Final result of `ynh agent run --format json`. One object per run, emitted on every path — converged or not, because a run that did not converge is the one worth investigating. Distinct from `--emit-jsonl`, which is an event stream. Goes to stderr when `--emit-jsonl -` is streaming the trajectory to stdout, so NDJSON stays clean.

capabilities.description: Wire-protocol version. See CLAUDE.md capability-bump rule.

ynh_version.description: Binary release version or dev-build identifier.

exit_code.description: Mirrors the process exit code, so a consumer reading this and a consumer branching on $? never disagree. 0 converged; 10 turn cap; 11 token budget; 12 wall clock; 13 stuck; 14 tamper — the baseline moved during the run; 15 plan-iteration cap; 20 worker error; 21 resume error; 22 gate error — `ynh check` could not run; 30 aborted by user; 31 interrupted.

reason.description: Why the run ended, when it was not a clean convergence.

converged.description: True only when the sensors agreed the work was done. Never true alongside a non-zero exit_code.

session_dir.description: Directory holding the checkpoint, trajectory and any recorded gate-write attempts.

worktree.description: Directory the agent worked in and sensors ran against.

backend.description: Worker backend that drove the agent.

model.description: The model the worker reported it ran on, as the backend states it, with an alias resolved to its id (Claude Code: `sonnet` becomes `claude-sonnet-5-5`). Absent when the backend reported none (Codex reports none); never filled in from `model_requested`. After a resume, the latest worker process's.

model_requested.description: The model this run asked for with --model, as given. Absent when none was pinned and the backend chose its default. Not restored by --resume, as --model is not.

auto_approve.description: The --auto-approve level the worker ran with. Absent means none: no permission flag was passed to the worker.

effort.description: The reasoning effort the worker reported it ran with, in the backend's own terms (Claude Code: low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Absent means the backend did not report one, not that none was in force. Never inferred from the model name.

harness.description: The harness the run was verified against. Absent when no harness was named — such a run is a plain agent runner and was never asked to verify itself.

sha.description: Resolved commit the harness was installed from, recorded by `ynh install`. Version alone is an author-declared string that can be reused across different content; the SHA is what pins a run to one set of sensors.

budgets.description: The caps in force for this run.

budget_sources.description: Where each cap came from. A cap nobody chose that fires is noise in a batch of runs; a cap that was chosen and fires is a finding. These must be distinguishable.

consumed.description: What the run actually spent. Reported on failure as well as success.

tokens.description: Input plus output tokens. Cache reads and cache writes are not included.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens, summed over every turn including the plan phase. Absent when the backend reported no usage.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens, summed like input_tokens. Absent when the backend reported no usage.

cache_read_tokens.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache, not counted in tokens. Absent when the backend does not report a cache-read count.

cache_creation_tokens.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache, summed per turn like cache_read_tokens and not counted in tokens. Their cost is already inside cost_usd. Absent when the backend does not report a cache-write count; zero only when it reported zero.

cost_usd.description: Cost in US dollars as the backend reported it, summed over the run. ynh never prices tokens itself. Absent when the backend reported no cost; zero only when it reported zero.

bound_by.description: Which cap ended the run. Absent when no cap bound it.

convergence.description: The convergence-verifier's last word. Absent means none was declared, which is different from one that ran and disagreed.

sensors.description: The final gate result — the evidence behind `converged`. Same per-sensor shape as `ynh check --format json`.

changed_files.description: Paths the run modified relative to base_commit, including new files. A converged run that changed nothing, and a run that rewrote forty files nobody asked about, are both findings.

image_digest.description: Digest of the container image this run executed in, from the YNH_IMAGE_DIGEST environment variable. A run cannot observe this for itself — a digest is computed after a build, and a process inside a container has no portable way to learn its own image — so the launcher passes it in. Absent means not recorded, not uncontainerised.
